    "content": "import { mutationGeneric, queryGeneric } from \"convex/server\";\nimport { v } from \"convex/values\";\n\nfunction nowMs() {\n  return Date.now();\n}\n\nconst navbarItem = v.union(\n  v.object({\n    type: v.literal(\"page\"),\n    pageId: v.id(\"pages\"),\n  }),\n  v.object({\n    type: v.literal(\"link\"),\n    label: v.string(),\n    url: v.string(),\n  }),\n);\n\nexport const get = queryGeneric({\n  args: { key: v.optional(v.string()) },\n  handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {\n    const key = args.key ?? \"main\";\n    return await ctx.db\n      .query(\"navbars\")\n      .withIndex(\"by_key\", (q) =&gt; q.eq(\"key\", key))\n      .unique();\n  },\n});\n\nexport const setItems = mutationGeneric({\n  args: { key: v.optional(v.string()), items: v.array(navbarItem) },\n  handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {\n    const key = args.key ?? \"main\";\n    const ts = nowMs();\n\n    const existing = await ctx.db\n      .query(\"navbars\")\n      .withIndex(\"by_key\", (q) =&gt; q.eq(\"key\", key))\n      .unique();\n\n    if (!existing) {\n      return await ctx.db.insert(\"navbars\", {\n        key,\n        items: args.items,\n        createdAt: ts,\n        updatedAt: ts,\n      });\n    }\n\n    await ctx.db.patch(existing._id, { items: args.items, updatedAt: ts });\n    return existing._id;\n  },\n});\n\n",
    "languageId": "typescript"
  }
}

    "content": "\"use client\";\n\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport * as React from \"react\";\nimport { useMutation, useQuery } from \"convex/react\";\nimport { anyApi } from \"convex/server\";\nimport type { NavbarDoc, NavbarItem, PageDoc } from \"@/lib/cmsTypes\";\nimport { getTemplateLabel, type TemplateKey, templates } from \"@/lib/templates\";\n\nconst api = anyApi;\n\ntype UiNavbarItem = NavbarItem &amp; { _key: string };\n\nfunction newClientKey() {\n  return &#96;${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}&#96;;\n}\n\nfunction CmsHomeWithConvex() {\n  const pages = useQuery(api.pages.list, {}) as PageDoc[] | undefined;\n  const create = useMutation(api.pages.create);\n  const remove = useMutation(api.pages.remove);\n  const navbar = useQuery(api.navbar.get, {}) as NavbarDoc | null | undefined;\n  const setNavbarItems = useMutation(api.navbar.setItems);\n\n  const [title, setTitle] = React.useState(\"\");\n  const [slug, setSlug] = React.useState(\"\");\n  const [template, setTemplate] = React.useState&lt;TemplateKey&gt;(\"basic\");\n  const [error, setError] = React.useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = React.useState(false);\n\n  const pagesById = React.useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    const m = new Map&lt;string, PageDoc&gt;();\n    for (const p of pages ?? []) m.set(p._id, p);\n    return m;\n  }, [pages]);\n\n  const [navItems, setNavItems] = React.useState&lt;UiNavbarItem[]&gt;([]);\n  const [navDirty, setNavDirty] = React.useState(false);\n  const [navError, setNavError] = React.useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [navIsSaving, setNavIsSaving] = React.useState(false);\n\n  const [newNavPageId, setNewNavPageId] = React.useState(\"\");\n  const [newNavLinkLabel, setNewNavLinkLabel] = React.useState(\"\");\n  const [newNavLinkUrl, setNewNavLinkUrl] = React.useState(\"\");\n\n  React.useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (navbar === undefined) return; // loading\n    if (navDirty) return;\n    const items = (navbar?.items ?? []) as NavbarItem[];\n    setNavItems(items.map((it) =&gt; ({ ...it, _key: newClientKey() })));\n  }, [navbar, navDirty]);\n\n  async function onCreate(e: React.FormEvent) {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsCreating(true);\n    try {\n      const content = template === \"home\" ? templates.home.defaultContent : {};\n      const id = await create({\n        title,\n        slug: slug.trim() ? slug : undefined,\n        template,\n        content,\n      });\n      setTitle(\"\");\n      setSlug(\"\");\n      window.location.href = &#96;/cms/pages/${id}&#96;;\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : \"Failed to create page\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsCreating(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  function moveNavItem(idx: number, dir: -1 | 1) {\n    setNavItems((prev) =&gt; {\n      const next = prev.slice();\n      const to = idx + dir;\n      if (to &lt; 0 || to &gt;= next.length) return prev;\n      const [item] = next.splice(idx, 1);\n      next.splice(to, 0, item);\n      return next;\n    });\n    setNavDirty(true);\n  }\n\n  function updateNavItem(key: string, patch: Partial&lt;NavbarItem&gt;) {\n    setNavItems((prev) =&gt;\n      prev.map((it) =&gt; (it._key === key ? ({ ...it, ...patch } as UiNavbarItem) : it)),\n    );\n    setNavDirty(true);\n  }\n\n  function removeNavItem(key: string) {\n    setNavItems((prev) =&gt; prev.filter((it) =&gt; it._key !== key));\n    setNavDirty(true);\n  }\n\n  function addNavPageItem() {\n    if (!newNavPageId) return;\n    setNavItems((prev) =&gt; [...prev, { type: \"page\", pageId: newNavPageId, _key: newClientKey() }]);\n    setNavDirty(true);\n    setNewNavPageId(\"\");\n  }\n\n  function addNavLinkItem() {\n    const label = newNavLinkLabel.trim();\n    const url = newNavLinkUrl.trim();\n    if (!label || !url) return;\n    setNavItems((prev) =&gt; [...prev, { type: \"link\", label, url, _key: newClientKey() }]);\n    setNavDirty(true);\n    setNewNavLinkLabel(\"\");\n    setNewNavLinkUrl(\"\");\n  }\n\n  async function onSaveNavbar() {\n    setNavError(null);\n    setNavIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await setNavbarItems({\n        items: navItems.map(({ _key, ...it }) =&gt; it),\n      });\n      setNavDirty(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setNavError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : \"Failed to save navbar\");\n    } finally {\n      setNavIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-zinc-50 px-6 py-16 font-sans text-zinc-900 dark:bg-black dark:text-zinc-50\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-10\"&gt;\n        &lt;header className=\"flex items-center justify-between gap-4\"&gt;\n          &lt;div&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight\"&gt;CMS&lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400\"&gt;\n              Create and edit pages.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;Link className=\"text-sm font-medium underline\" href=\"/\"&gt;\n            Home\n          &lt;/Link&gt;\n        &lt;/header&gt;\n\n        &lt;section className=\"rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950\"&gt;\n          &lt;h2 className=\"text-sm font-semibold\"&gt;New page&lt;/h2&gt;\n          &lt;form className=\"mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3\" onSubmit={onCreate}&gt;\n            &lt;label className=\"flex flex-col gap-1\"&gt;\n              &lt;span className=\"text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400\"&gt;\n                Title\n              &lt;/span&gt;\n              &lt;input\n                value={title}\n                onChange={(e) =&gt; []).map((p) =&gt; (\n              &lt;div key={p._id} className=\"flex items-center justify-between gap-4 py-3\"&gt;\n                &lt;div className=\"min-w-0\"&gt;\n                  &lt;div className=\"truncate text-sm font-medium\"&gt;{p.title}&lt;/div&gt;\n                  &lt;div className=\"truncate text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400\"&gt;\n                    /{p.slug} {p.published ? \"• published\" : \"• draft\"}\n                  &lt;/div&gt;\n                &lt;/div&gt;\n                &lt;div className=\"flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3\"&gt;\n                  &lt;Link\n                    className=\"text-sm font-medium underline\"\n                    href={&#96;/cms/pages/${p._id}&#96;}\n                  &gt;\n                    Edit\n                  &lt;/Link&gt;\n                  &lt;button\n                    className=\"text-sm font-medium text-red-700 underline dark:text-red-400\"\n                    onClick={async () =&gt; {\n                      if (!confirm(&#96;Delete \"${p.title}\"?&#96;)) return;\n                      await remove({ id: p._id });\n                    }}\n                  &gt;\n                    Delete\n                  &lt;/button&gt;\n                &lt;/div&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n            ))}\n            {pages &amp;&amp; pages.length === 0 ?   "contentsAfterEdit": "\"use client\";\n\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport * as React from \"react\";\nimport { useMutation, useQuery } from \"convex/react\";\nimport { anyApi } from \"convex/server\";\nimport type { NavbarDoc, NavbarItem, PageDoc } from \"@/lib/cmsTypes\";\nimport { getTemplateLabel, type TemplateKey, templates } from \"@/lib/templates\";\n\nconst api = anyApi;\n\ntype UiNavbarItem = NavbarItem &amp; { _key: string };\n\nfunction newClientKey() {\n  return &#96;${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}&#96;;\n}\n\nfunction CmsHomeWithConvex() {\n  const pages = useQuery(api.pages.list, {}) as PageDoc[] | undefined;\n  const create = useMutation(api.pages.create);\n  const remove = useMutation(api.pages.remove);\n  const navbar = useQuery(api.navbar.get, {}) as NavbarDoc | null | undefined;\n  const setNavbarItems = useMutation(api.navbar.setItems);\n\n  const [title, setTitle] = React.useState(\"\");\n  const [slug, setSlug] = React.useState(\"\");\n  const [template, setTemplate] = React.useState&lt;TemplateKey&gt;(\"basic\");\n  const [error, setError] = React.useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = React.useState(false);\n\n  const pagesById = React.useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    const m = new Map&lt;string, PageDoc&gt;();\n    for (const p of pages ?? []) m.set(p._id, p);\n    return m;\n  }, [pages]);\n\n  const [navItems, setNavItems] = React.useState&lt;UiNavbarItem[]&gt;([]);\n  const [navDirty, setNavDirty] = React.useState(false);\n  const [navError, setNavError] = React.useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [navIsSaving, setNavIsSaving] = React.useState(false);\n\n  const [newNavPageId, setNewNavPageId] = React.useState(\"\");\n  const [newNavLinkLabel, setNewNavLinkLabel] = React.useState(\"\");\n  const [newNavLinkUrl, setNewNavLinkUrl] = React.useState(\"\");\n\n  React.useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (navbar === undefined) return; // loading\n    if (navDirty) return;\n    const items = (navbar?.items ?? []) as NavbarItem[];\n    setNavItems(items.map((it) =&gt; ({ ...it, _key: newClientKey() })));\n  }, [navbar, navDirty]);\n\n  async function onCreate(e: React.FormEvent) {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsCreating(true);\n    try {\n      const content = template === \"home\" ? templates.home.defaultContent : {};\n      const id = await create({\n        title,\n        slug: slug.trim() ? slug : undefined,\n        template,\n        content,\n      });\n      setTitle(\"\");\n      setSlug(\"\");\n      window.location.href = &#96;/cms/pages/${id}&#96;;\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : \"Failed to create page\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsCreating(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  function moveNavItem(idx: number, dir: -1 | 1) {\n    setNavItems((prev) =&gt; {\n      const next = prev.slice();\n      const to = idx + dir;\n      if (to &lt; 0 || to &gt;= next.length) return prev;\n      const [item] = next.splice(idx, 1);\n      next.splice(to, 0, item);\n      return next;\n    });\n    setNavDirty(true);\n  }\n\n  function updateNavItem(key: string, patch: Partial&lt;NavbarItem&gt;) {\n    setNavItems((prev) =&gt;\n      prev.map((it) =&gt; (it._key === key ? ({ ...it, ...patch } as UiNavbarItem) : it)),\n    );\n    setNavDirty(true);\n  }\n\n  function removeNavItem(key: string) {\n    setNavItems((prev) =&gt; prev.filter((it) =&gt; it._key !== key));\n    setNavDirty(true);\n  }\n\n  function addNavPageItem() {\n    if (!newNavPageId) return;\n    setNavItems((prev) =&gt; [...prev, { type: \"page\", pageId: newNavPageId, _key: newClientKey() }]);\n    setNavDirty(true);\n    setNewNavPageId(\"\");\n  }\n\n  function addNavLinkItem() {\n    const label = newNavLinkLabel.trim();\n    const url = newNavLinkUrl.trim();\n    if (!label || !url) return;\n    setNavItems((prev) =&gt; [...prev, { type: \"link\", label, url, _key: newClientKey() }]);\n    setNavDirty(true);\n    setNewNavLinkLabel(\"\");\n    setNewNavLinkUrl(\"\");\n  }\n\n  async function onSaveNavbar() {\n    setNavError(null);\n    setNavIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await setNavbarItems({\n        items: navItems.map(({ _key, ...it }) =&gt; it),\n      });\n      setNavDirty(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setNavError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : \"Failed to save navbar\");\n    } finally {\n      setNavIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-zinc-50 px-6 py-16 font-sans text-zinc-900 dark:bg-black dark:text-zinc-50\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-10\"&gt;\n        &lt;header className=\"flex items-center justify-between gap-4\"&gt;\n          &lt;div&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight\"&gt;CMS&lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400\"&gt;\n              Create and edit pages.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;Link className=\"text-sm font-medium underline\" href=\"/\"&gt;\n            Home\n          &lt;/Link&gt;\n        &lt;/header&gt;\n\n        &lt;section className=\"rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950\"&gt;\n          &lt;h2 className=\"text-sm font-semibold\"&gt;New page&lt;/h2&gt;\n          &lt;form className=\"mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3\" onSubmit={onCreate}&gt;\n            &lt;label className=\"flex flex-col gap-1\"&gt;\n              &lt;span className=\"text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400\"&gt;\n                Title\n              &lt;/span&gt;\n              &lt;input\n                value={title}\n                onChange={(e) =&gt; ### What I added

- **New “Navbar” card on `/cms` (below “Pages”)** where you can manage an ordered list of items:
  - **Page item**: references an existing Page
  - **Link item**: requires **Label** + **URL**
  - Supports **reordering (Up/Down)**, **editing**, and **removing**, plus an explicit **Save navbar** button.

### Convex persistence

- **New `navbars` table** in `convex/schema.ts` storing:
  - `key` (defaults to `"main"`)
  - `items` (array of `{type:"page", pageId}` or `{type:"link", label, url}`)
  - timestamps
- **New Convex functions** in `convex/navbar.ts`:
  - `get` (load navbar)
  - `setItems` (create/update + save the full list)

### Files changed

- `convex/schema.ts`
- `convex/navbar.ts`
- `src/app/cms/page.tsx`

If you run Convex dev (`npm run convex:dev`) and reload `/cms`, you should see the new Navbar card and changes should persist after saving.

### Done: Navbar wrapper for all `/[slug]` pages

- **Created a reusable client navbar component** that reads navbar items from Convex and renders:
  - **Page items** → links to the referenced published page’s `/${slug}`
  - **Link items** → internal links use `next/link`, external links open in a new tab
- **Wrapped all pages under `src/app/[slug]`** with this navbar (loading / not-found / draft / published states all show it).
- Also **removed the `as any`** in `src/app/[slug]/page.tsx` by properly coercing to `TemplateKey`.

### Files added/changed

- **Added** `src/components/SiteNavbar.tsx`
- **Updated** `src/app/[slug]/page.tsx`

### Home page redirect behavior added

If **any navbar items exist**, `/` now **redirects to the first resolvable navbar item**:

- **Link item**: redirects to its URL (external URLs use `window.location.href`)
- **Page item**: resolves the referenced published page and redirects to `/${slug}`
- If the first item can’t be resolved (e.g. page not published), it **skips to the next**.
- Guard: if the target is already `/`, it won’t loop.

### File changed

- `src/app/page.tsx`

Yep — that’s coming from `Shell` adding `px-6` *and* some templates (like `HomeTemplate`) already adding their own `px-6`, so you see doubled horizontal padding. I’ll make `Shell` handle only the navbar/background and move padding to the non-template fallbacks so templates control their own layout.

### Implemented: public stays light, CMS stays dark

- **Switched Tailwind dark mode to class-based** so we can force dark only where we want:
  - Added `tailwind.config.ts` with `darkMode: ["class"]`
- **Forced CMS to dark** regardless of OS theme:
  - Added `src/app/cms/layout.tsx` that wraps CMS routes in a `.dark` ancestor
- **Forced templates + navbar to light** (even inside CMS preview):
  - Removed `dark:*` variants from:
    - `src/components/SiteNavbar.tsx`
    - `src/lib/templates/home.tsx`
    - `src/app/cms/preview/page.tsx`
    - `src/app/page.tsx`
    - `src/app/[slug]/page.tsx`
- **Stopped global OS-based theme switching** so the site doesn’t flip with system dark mode:
  - Removed the `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` override from `src/app/globals.css`

Result: **Templates + navbar are always light**, and **all `/cms/*` screens render in dark color schemes**.
